sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The gameplay in Funny Travelling Airport is centered around guiding passengers through various stages, from check-in to takeoff. Players must collect and sort luggage, manage baggage carts, and ensure that passengers reach their gates on time. As players progress through each stage, the challenges become increasingly difficult, requiring quick thinking and strategic decision-making. With each completed stage, players earn rewards and achievements, which can be used to unlock new levels or items.

One of the unique features of Funny Travelling Airport is its use of a 'time management' system, where players must balance the time it takes to complete each task with the limited time available. This adds an extra layer of complexity to the gameplay, as players must think carefully about their priorities and allocate their resources effectively. Additionally, the game features a variety of power-ups and bonuses, which can be used to improve gameplay and increase efficiency.

The gameplay mechanics are designed to be easy to learn but challenging to master, making it accessible to a wide range of players. The game's intuitive interface and simple controls make it easy for kids to pick up and play, while the addictive nature of the gameplay ensures that they'll want to keep coming back for more. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of browser games, Funny Travelling Airport is an experience you won't want to miss.

The game's core mechanics are built around three main stages: check-in, security, and boarding. In the check-in stage, players must collect and sort luggage, while in the security stage, they must manage baggage carts and ensure that passengers reach their gates on time. The boarding stage is the final stage, where players must guide passengers to their seats and ensure that they have a smooth and comfortable flight.
